children.text: Welcome to the 1st day of Ramadan. Let us dedicate this time to self-discipline and reflection.
Tip for the Day:
Set a clear intention for the whole month today.
Ramadan Mubarak to our community!
On this 2nd day, remember that fasting encompasses not just food, but also our words and actions.
Tip for the Day:
Make a conscious effort to avoid idle talk today.
Ramadan Mubarak to our community!
3rd day of Ramadan: The first 10 days are the days of Mercy.
Tip for the Day:
Constantly seek Allah's mercy through the simple dua: 'O My Lord, forgive me and have mercy upon me.'
Ramadan Mubarak to our community!
4th day of Ramadan: Charity extinguishes sin as water extinguishes fire.
Tip for the Day:
Donate a small amount to charity today, even if it's just a smile or helping hand.
Ramadan Mubarak to our community!
5th day of Ramadan: Consistency is key. It's better to do small good deeds every day than a lot at once.
Tip for the Day:
Commit to reading just 2 pages of Quran after every prayer.
Ramadan Mubarak to our community!
6th day of Ramadan: Patience is half of faith.
Tip for the Day:
When you feel tested today, take a deep breath and say 'Alhamdulillah'.
Ramadan Mubarak to our community!
7th day of Ramadan: Establish your prayers. Salah is the first thing we will be asked about.
Tip for the Day:
Try to pray all sunnah prayers along with the fard prayers today.
Ramadan Mubarak to our community!
8th day of Ramadan: Gratitude increases blessings. Be thankful for the food you break your fast with.
Tip for the Day:
Make a list of 5 things you are deeply thankful for.
Ramadan Mubarak to our community!
9th day of Ramadan: Strengthen your ties of kinship.
Tip for the Day:
Call a family member or relative you haven't spoken to in a while.
Ramadan Mubarak to our community!
10th day of Ramadan: As we conclude the days of Mercy, we enter the days of Forgiveness.
Tip for the Day:
Reflect on your past mistakes and sincerely ask for forgiveness.
Ramadan Mubarak to our community!
11th day of Ramadan: The Prophet (PBUH) was the most generous of people, especially in Ramadan.
Tip for the Day:
Find an opportunity to be unexpectedly generous to someone today.
Ramadan Mubarak to our community!
12th day of Ramadan: Your health is a trust (amanah). Eat wholesome food for Suhoor and Iftar.
Tip for the Day:
Break your fast with dates and water, and avoid overeating.
Ramadan Mubarak to our community!
13th day of Ramadan: Knowledge is light. Use this month to increase your Islamic knowledge.
Tip for the Day:
Listen to an Islamic lecture or read a chapter from a beneficial book.
Ramadan Mubarak to our community!
14th day of Ramadan: A good word is a charity.
Tip for the Day:
Compliment someone sincerely or encourage a fellow fasting brother/sister.
Ramadan Mubarak to our community!
15th day of Ramadan: We are halfway through the blessed month. Renew your intentions.
Tip for the Day:
Evaluate your goals from day 1 and adjust where necessary to finish strong.
Ramadan Mubarak to our community!
16th day of Ramadan: Dua is the weapon of the believer. The dua of a fasting person is not rejected.
Tip for the Day:
Make a special dua just before breaking your fast.
Ramadan Mubarak to our community!
17th day of Ramadan: The Battle of Badr took place on this day. It's a reminder that Allah grants victory to those who strive.
Tip for the Day:
Reflect on the struggles of the early Muslims and draw strength from them.
Ramadan Mubarak to our community!
18th day of Ramadan: Be mindful of your time. Don't waste the precious remaining days.
Tip for the Day:
Limit your social media usage to focus on spiritual connection.
Ramadan Mubarak to our community!
19th day of Ramadan: Prepare for the last ten nights. The best is yet to come.
Tip for the Day:
Start adjusting your sleep schedule to ensure you can stay awake during the nights.
Ramadan Mubarak to our community!
20th day of Ramadan: Entering the last 10 days—the days of seeking refuge from the Fire.
Tip for the Day:
Increase your recitation of the Quran and your nighttime prayers.
Ramadan Mubarak to our community!
21st day of Ramadan: Seek Laylatul Qadr (The Night of Decree), better than a thousand months.
Tip for the Day:
Recite the recommended dua for Laylatul Qadr abundantly.
Ramadan Mubarak to our community!
22nd day of Ramadan: I'tikaf is a beautiful sunnah of disconnecting from the world.
Tip for the Day:
Even if you can't stay at the masjid, spend a dedicated hour in a quiet room for pure ibadah.
Ramadan Mubarak to our community!
23rd day of Ramadan: Another odd night. Stay vigilant in prayer and supplication.
Tip for the Day:
Donate a small amount tonight; if it is Laylatul Qadr, it's as if you donated for 83 years!
Ramadan Mubarak to our community!
24th day of Ramadan: Forgive others, so that Allah may forgive you.
Tip for the Day:
Let go of any grudges you hold in your heart today.
Ramadan Mubarak to our community!
25th day of Ramadan: Keep pushing forward. Fatigue is normal, but the reward is eternal.
Tip for the Day:
Remind yourself of the gates of Rayyan, reserved specifically for those who fast.
Ramadan Mubarak to our community!
26th day of Ramadan: Every moment is precious now. Less sleep, more prayer.
Tip for the Day:
Make sincere dua for the global Muslim ummah who are facing hardships.
Ramadan Mubarak to our community!
27th day of Ramadan: Often considered the most likely night for Laylatul Qadr.
Tip for the Day:
Exhaust yourself in good deeds and sincere repentance tonight.
Ramadan Mubarak to our community!
28th day of Ramadan: As the month wraps up, reflect on your spiritual journey.
Tip for the Day:
Write down the positive habits you've built and plan how to maintain them.
Ramadan Mubarak to our community!
29th day of Ramadan: Zakat al-Fitr purifies our fasting. Ensure it is paid before the Eid prayer.
Tip for the Day:
Pay your Zakat al-Fitr today if you haven't already.
Ramadan Mubarak to our community!
30th day of Ramadan: We bid farewell to this blessed guest. May Allah accept from us all.
Tip for the Day:
Look out for the Eid moon and prepare your heart for the joy of Eid.
Ramadan Mubarak to our community!
